premium.title: Unlock your Premium side
premium.subtitle: Badges, frames, themes and exclusive spaces. Essential features stay free — and Premium never gives ranking advantages.
premium.changeAtPeriodEnd: You can switch plans when the current period ends.
premium.secureNote: Secure payment by InfinitePay: Pix or card in up to 12 installments. We never store your card data.

payment.a: You go to InfinitePay's secure page and pay with Pix or credit card (up to 12 installments). Once the payment is confirmed, benefits unlock automatically.

renewal.a: No. Each payment unlocks one period (month or year). We email you 3 days before it ends and you renew in one click — no surprise charges.

cancel.a: Yes, anytime: benefits last until the end of the paid period. Online purchases can be withdrawn within 7 days under Brazilian consumer law — contact support.

fair.a: Not in rankings or XP. Premium is about identity, customization and special spaces. The whole essential community stays free.
